78331.subject: 🔷 The Daily: Strategy resumes bitcoin buying
78331.body:
Strategy resumes bitcoin buying | Hyperliquid seeks U.S. entry through Kraken parent Payward | OpenSea set to bring back Solana NFT trading | Kalshi permanently bans George Santos | Cronos network halts after Tectonic exploit

The Daily ( https://www.theblock.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Written by Yogita Khatri | Edited by Kyle Baird

Presented By:

( https://thezcashetf.com/?utm_campaign=website-traffic-zcsh-newsletters--2026-08-25&utm_medium=paid-other&utm_source=the-block&utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Happy Monday! Yogita here, filling in for James, with the latest from the crypto world.

Bitcoin is holding around $78,800. *Strategy bought another 4,603 BTC* for nearly $370 million after a 10-week pause in purchases, and *Strive* *added* ( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-08-31-strive-fifth-largest-public-bitcoin-treasury-1800-btc-buy-td-cowen-lifts-asst-price-target-413112?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) *1,800 BTC* to become the fifth-largest public bitcoin treasury. *Bitmine also* *added* ( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-08-31-tom-lee-says-ether-best-performing-macro-asset-bitmine-adds-53501-eth-413105?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) *another 53,501 ETH* as Tom Lee called ether the "best performing macro asset."

*Hyperliquid is reportedly seeking a U.S. foothold through a deal with Kraken parent Payward* , while *OpenSea is adding Solana NFT trading* ( https://www.theblock.co/news/markets/2026-08-31-opensea-solana-nft-trading-413128?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) ** more than four years after its initial beta.

The Crypto.com-linked *Cronos network halted* following an exploit of lending protocol *Tectonic* , with *losses estimated at $75 million*.

In prediction markets, *Kalshi* reportedly became ( https://www.theblock.co/news/deals/2026-08-30-kalshi-becomes-exclusive-prediction-market-partner-of-us-open-report-413074?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) the US Open's exclusive prediction market partner. The platform also permanently *banned former Rep. George Santos* over State of the Union insider trading.

*P.S.* Don't forget to check out today's reader poll on a *September Fed rate hike* later in the newsletter.

*THE BIG ONE*

*🟠 Strategy resumes bitcoin buying with $370 million purchase*

( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-08-31-were-back-strategy-buys-another-4603-btc-369-7-million-holdings-hit-845050-btc-413087?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

*Strategy* bought 4,603 BTC for about $369.7 million between Aug. 24 and Aug. 30 at an average price of $80,318 per bitcoin.

Bringing global finance onchain



 
Highlights
 
Aave App Enters Early Access on iOS
Early access to the Aave App started on August 26 on iOS. The first cohort of users received Ghost Passes, which are invites that
let friends and family skip the waitlist. More passes are being given out through the Aave Instagram, Telegram, and on X.
Announcement here [https://x.com/aave/status/2092643144139424046].
 
Coinbase Tokenized Stocks Coming to V4
Coinbase Tokenized Stocks went live on Base, and Aave V4 will be the first credit market to fully support them. Once V4 is
deployed on Base, users will be able to borrow stablecoins against tokenized stocks. Only available in eligible geos outside the
U.S. Announcement here [https://x.com/aave/status/2091964981675704495].
 
Aave V4 Crosses $800M Deposits
Aave V4 crossed $800 million deposits on August 27, while active loans set a new all-time high. Announcement here
[https://x.com/aave/status/2093013562788598243].
 
New incentives are also live for USDC borrowers [https://x.com/aave/status/2094433298567090579] in the Core Hub on Ethereum.
Borrow USDC against any available collateral and earn 2% back in USDC rewards.
 
EtherFi Cash Now Runs on V4
EtherFi moved its Cash credit backend to a dedicated Aave V4 instance on Optimism, letting more than 100,000 cardholders borrow
against their portfolios. Supported collateral includes PAXG, SPYx, WBTC, ETH, and ETHFI, with more coming as the integration
expands. Deposits on the deployment crossed $100 million in its first week. Announcement here
[https://x.com/aave/status/2088265181230969095].
